biocontainers.name: bioconductor-basilisk
biocontainers.summary: Freezing Python Versions Inside Bioconductor Packages

biotools.summary: Installs a self-contained conda instance that is managed by the R/Bioconductor installation machinery. This aims to provide a consistent Python environment that can be used reliably by Bioconductor packages. Functions are also provided to enable smooth interoperability of multiple Python environments in a single R session.
